gloss: kampaku; chief adviser to the Emperor

definitions.explanation: The highest office at the imperial court from the Heian period on: a regent who assisted an adult emperor. Toyotomi Hideyoshi held the title. Today the word lives on mainly in {亭主関白|ていしゅかんぱく}, a husband who rules the household.

examples.japanese: ⟦{豊臣秀吉|とよとみひでよし}→豊臣秀吉：30993_toyotomihideyoshi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{関白|かんぱく}になった。
{藤原氏|ふじわらし}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{摂政|せっしょう}や{関白|かんぱく}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{権力|けんりょく}→権力：10020_kenryoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{握|にぎ}った→握る：02383_nigiru⟧。
examples.english: The Fujiwara clan held power as regents and as kampaku.

examples.japanese: うち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{昔|むかし}ながら→昔ながら：26817_mukashinagara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{亭主関白|ていしゅかんぱく}→亭主関白：26899_teishukanpaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{家事|かじ}→家事：12313_kaji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{一切|いっさい}→一切：06662_issai⟧⟦しない→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: My father is an old-fashioned lord of the house and does no housework at all.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {関白|かんぱく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become kampaku
- {摂政|せっしょう}{関白|かんぱく}: the two regent offices together
- ⟦{亭主関白|ていしゅかんぱく}→亭主関白：26899_teishukanpaku⟧: a husband who lords it over his wife

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {摂政|せっしょう}: regent for a child or female ruler; the {関白|かんぱく} assisted an adult emperor
- {太閤|たいこう}: title of a retired kampaku, used above all for Hideyoshi

CULTURAL NOTE:
The 1979 song 「{関白宣言|かんぱくせんげん}」 by Masashi Sada made the word familiar as a joking image of a bossy husband.
